notes: Three taḥwīl branches of one saying. The first two («قالا أخبرنا ابن جريج») end at Ibn Jurayj as the text writes them, so no tail is shared and Nafiʿ belongs to the third branch only.
The third branch writes «قال قال ابن جريج أخبرني نافع»: Ibn Jurayj is its own link (occurrence 2).
«واللفظ له» marks the third branch as the wording source; it is kept as a route, not as a variant.
